arguments.query: select table_name, (xpath('/row/c/text()', xml_count))[1]::text::int as row_count from (select table_name, query_to_xml(format('select count(*) as c from public.%I', table_name), false, true, '') as xml_count from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public' and table_type='BASE TABLE' order by table_name) t order by row_count desc, table_name
